docs.summary: Citation component for building user interfaces.
usage: Use Citation to communicate status or feedback to users. This component provides visual indicators that help users understand the current state or outcome.
Citation is effective for showing status, progress, or results. Use it consistently throughout your application to maintain clear communication patterns.

anatomy.description: Citation is composed of the following parts:

bestPractices.title: Use appropriate severity
bestPractices.description: Match the citation visual style to the message importance.

bestPractices.title: Don't overuse
bestPractices.description: Avoid showing too many citation instances at once.

bestPractices.title: Provide context
bestPractices.description: Include clear, actionable information in the citation.

bestPractices.title: Maintain consistency
bestPractices.description: Use the same patterns throughout your application.
